***REMOVED*** quick-lru [![Build Status](https://travis-ci.org/sindresorhus/quick-lru.svg?branch=master)](https://travis-ci.org/sindresorhus/quick-lru) [![Coverage Status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/sindresorhus/quick-lru/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://coveralls.io/github/sindresorhus/quick-lru?branch=master)

> Simple [“Least Recently Used” (LRU) cache](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cache_replacement_policies***REMOVED***Least_Recently_Used_.28LRU.29)

Useful when you need to cache something and limit memory usage.

Inspired by the [`hashlru` algorithm](https://github.com/dominictarr/hashlru***REMOVED***algorithm), but instead uses [`Map`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Map) to support keys of any type, not just strings, and values can be `undefined`.

***REMOVED******REMOVED*** Install

```
$ npm install quick-lru
```

***REMOVED******REMOVED*** Usage

```js
const QuickLRU = require('quick-lru');

const lru = new QuickLRU({maxSize: 1000});

lru.set('🦄', '🌈');

lru.has('🦄');
//=> true

lru.get('🦄');
//=> '🌈'
```

***REMOVED******REMOVED*** API

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** new QuickLRU(options?)

Returns a new instance.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** options

Type: `object`

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** maxSize

*Required*\
Type: `number`

The maximum number of items before evicting the least recently used items.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** maxAge

Type: `number`\
Default: `Infinity`

The maximum number of milliseconds an item should remain in cache.
By default maxAge will be Infinity, which means that items will never expire.

Lazy expiration happens upon the next `write` or `read` call.

Individual expiration of an item can be specified by the `set(key, value, options)` method.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** onEviction

*Optional*\
Type: `(key, value) => void`

Called right before an item is evicted from the cache.

Useful for side effects or for items like object URLs that need explicit cleanup (`revokeObjectURL`).

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** Instance

The instance is [`iterable`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Iteration_protocols) so you can use it directly in a [`for…of`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/for...of) loop.

Both `key` and `value` can be of any type.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .set(key, value, options?)

Set an item. Returns the instance.

Individual expiration of an item can be specified with the `maxAge` option. If not specified, the global `maxAge` value will be used in case it is specified on the constructor, otherwise the item will never expire.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .get(key)

Get an item.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .has(key)

Check if an item exists.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .peek(key)

Get an item without marking it as recently used.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .delete(key)

Delete an item.

Returns `true` if the item is removed or `false` if the item doesn't exist.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .clear()

Delete all items.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .resize(maxSize)

Update the `maxSize`, discarding items as necessary. Insertion order is mostly preserved, though this is not a strong guarantee.

Useful for on-the-fly tuning of cache sizes in live systems.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .keys()

Iterable for all the keys.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .values()

Iterable for all the values.

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .entriesAscending()

Iterable for all entries, starting with the oldest (ascending in recency).

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .entriesDescending()

Iterable for all entries, starting with the newest (descending in recency).

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** .size

The stored item count.
